name: commerce-os
description: Commerce OS: governed product preparation for two independent storefronts. A router (commerce-lead) and four specialist agents - intake-assets, product-intelligence, catalog-draft, review-publishing - run twelve skills from Drive intake through image preparation, classification, variant grouping, catalog retrieval, drafting, destination mapping, review packaging, approval verification, publishing dry runs and reconciliation. Evidence-first: unknown facts stay unknown, and no agent writes to a storefront.
